headline: Four NC families, source-verified from their own bytes. AOC-CR-287 and AOC-CR-288 approved. AOC-CR-296 carries Roger's controlling owner disposition: prosecutor-controlled, not delivered as a participant filing. AOC-CR-298 is correction_required — its archived source is not a blank form.

verdicts.observed: Approved. The source is now verified from its own bytes: SHA-256 recomputed against the digest pinned in this family's committed source-record.json, byte length matched, and the visible 'AOC-CR-287, Rev. 12/25' on the source agrees with the pinned REV-2025-12. The source carries no widget value and none of the fixture facts, so it is a genuine blank form. The artifact is correct: six bound values, every one inside the rectangle its own map declares, no stray or duplicated value anywhere in the document, nothing clipped, flattened with no XFA, JavaScript or actions, page 2 word-for-word identical to the blank rendering, and every court, judge, clerk, prosecutor, attorney, agency, service, signature and decision region blank. Two historical objections are closed against these bytes and the third is confirmed still open by its own record and owned by another lane. Three advisories are recorded and none of them changes what this artifact does.

verdicts.observed: Unchanged by source verification, which passed: the bytes match the committed pin, the visible 'AOC-CR-296, Rev. 3/25' agrees with REV-2025-03, and the source is a clean blank form. The open question is not about the bytes. AOC-CR-296 is captioned 'DISTRICT ATTORNEY PETITION AND ORDER OF EXPUNCTION', its identity block is 'Name And Address Of Defendant', its signature block is 'District Attorney Name (type or print)', it states on its own face that it is filed by the district attorney and requires no filing fee, and page 2 closes with a NOTE TO DISTRICT ATTORNEY. The source record nevertheless classifies it participant_completed and participantFillable true, and the artifact is a prosecutor's instrument pre-filled with the participant's identity. Whether LegalEase should hand a participant a district attorney's petition is an owner's decision, and it governs whether the two technical corrections below are worth making. Both remain required if the family is kept.

ownerDisposition.effect: AOC-CR-296 is a district attorney's instrument. It is not delivered as a participant filing, so it does not seek platform-ready approval through the participant channel. The reviewer verdict is unchanged by this disposition; the disposition records what the owner decided about the family.

correctionsHeldBehindTheOwnerDisposition.observed: Both are refused with reason protected_page_region, category prosecutor, regionHeading 'DISTRICT ATTORNEY PETITION'. The finalized artifact shows 'Jordan Avery Reyes' on the first line of the defendant name-and-address box, an empty second line, and 'Springfield' on the fourth. The filing carries a name and a city and no street address.
correctionsHeldBehindTheOwnerDisposition.required: StreetAddr carries participant.street_address inside its own rectangle, as it does on AOC-CR-287, AOC-CR-288 and AOC-CR-298 where the same address block is bound without incident.
correctionsHeldBehindTheOwnerDisposition.smallestCorrection: Fix region attribution per WCB-B-REGION-ATTRIBUTION so the title-block line in the right-hand column is not treated as the governing heading for a widget in the left-hand column, then re-derive and re-render this family.

correctionsHeldBehindTheOwnerDisposition.fieldOrGeometry: DLState, rect x=177 y=602 w=45 h=16
correctionsHeldBehindTheOwnerDisposition.observed: DLState is bound to participant.state on factBasis field_name. The census records labelBasis 'no_printed_caption_within_reach', so the binder matched the token 'State' inside the field name alone. DLState is the second cell of the 'Drivers License No. | State | Race | Sex' row and sits immediately right of DLNo at x=37 w=138 on the same line; it is the state that issued the driver's licence, not the participant's state of residence. The canonical fixture hides the error because participant.state is 'XX' and both readings render identically.
correctionsHeldBehindTheOwnerDisposition.required: Either the field is refused, as the equivalent field is on the other three families in this shard — PetitionerState and DLState are refused on AOC-CR-287, AOC-CR-288 and AOC-CR-298 — or it is bound to a driver's-licence-state fact the platform actually holds.
correctionsHeldBehindTheOwnerDisposition.smallestCorrection: Add the driver's-licence cluster to the government_identifier rule's name test so DLState is refused on its name the way DLNo already is, then re-derive and re-render.

verdicts.observed: The pinned source NC__FORM__AOC-CR-298__...__REV-2025-07__EN.pdf carries the visible personal name 'Courtney Bailey' in its page content stream, in Arial-BoldMT at 10pt. The cell's caption immediately above it is Arial-ItalicMT at 7pt, as every caption on the form is, and the adjacent Date and Signature Of Records Officer cells are empty. None of the source's 107 widgets carries a value, so the name is not a field default: it is an entry that was flattened into the page. It is the only non-heading, non-title bold run in any of the four sources in this shard. The finalized artifact reproduces it exactly, and flattening makes it permanent. It lies in no declared widget rectangle, so no classification, refusal or protected-area check can reach it, and protected-fields-scan.json states its own basis as 'what the renderer wrote' — which is why every existing check reports this family clean. The string appears nowhere else in this repository.
verdicts.required: The pinned source for this family is a pristine blank AOC-CR-298 REV-2025-07 carrying no third party's name, and the artifacts are re-rendered from it.
verdicts.smallestCorrection: Re-acquire AOC-CR-298 REV-2025-07 as a blank form, repin its digest in source-record.json, and re-render this family. Separately, extend the protected-area check to audit what is visible inside a protected region rather than only what the renderer wrote — as written it cannot detect an inherited value, and this defect survived two review waves because of that.

secondCorrection.observed: Both records carry sourceUrl 'https://www.nccourts.gov/documents/forms/petition-and-order-of-expunction-under-gs-15a-1455-nonviolent-felonyies-instructions-for-petition-and-order-of-expunction-under-gs-15a-1455-nonviolent-felonyies'. That locator names nonviolent FELONIES and names the INSTRUCTIONS. The artifact it is attached to is AOC-CR-298, whose own printed title is 'PETITION AND ORDER OF EXPUNCTION UNDER G.S. 15A-145.5 (NONVIOLENT MISDEMEANOR(S))', whose footer reads 'AOC-CR-298, Rev. 7/25 (replaced AOC-CR-281 for nonviolent misdemeanor petitions)', and which states on its own face 'For expunction of nonviolent felonies under G.S. 15A-145.5, use form AOC-CR-297.' The URL does not contain the string AOC-CR-298. This is the only family of the four carrying a published locator; the other three correctly carry a master-library: archive locator and digest.
secondCorrection.required: The recorded sourceUrl resolves to AOC-CR-298 itself, or it is null and the archive path and digest stand as the locator.
secondCorrection.smallestCorrection: Null the sourceUrl for this family and let the master-library locator stand, as the other three families in this shard already do, or replace it with the AOC-CR-298 form URL after checking it resolves to this form.
